fields.name: report_title
fields.label: Report title
fields.help: Shown on the cover. Say what, where and when.

fields.name: organization_name
fields.label: Organization name
fields.help: The farm, land trust, agency or project the report is prepared under.

fields.name: preparer_name
fields.label: Prepared by (name)
fields.help: The person who assembled this report. Thicket cannot sign anything; this name does.

fields.name: preparer_role
fields.label: Preparer's role
fields.help: Relationship to the land or project, for example farm manager or project ecologist.

fields.name: prepared_for
fields.label: Prepared for
fields.help: Who will read it: a planner, certifier, verifier or reviewer.

fields.name: property_name
fields.label: Property name
fields.help: Name of the property or holding the sites belong to.

fields.name: property_address
fields.label: Property address
fields.help: Street address or a locating description of the property.

fields.name: county
fields.label: County
fields.help: County where the sites are.

fields.name: state
fields.label: State
fields.help: Two-letter state or province code.

fields.name: monitoring_objective
fields.example: Document grassland bird use of the rotationally grazed north pasture
fields.label: Monitoring objective
fields.help: One or two sentences on why the recordings were made and what they are meant to show.

fields.name: habitat_type
fields.label: Habitat type
fields.help: Dominant habitat at the monitored sites. Site records in Thicket can override this per site.

fields.name: land_use
fields.label: Land use
fields.help: How the land is used during the monitoring period.

fields.name: site_field_map
fields.label: Site to field mapping
fields.help: Which Thicket site sits in which FSA field number or paddock, one row per site.

fields.name: recorder_make
fields.label: Recorder make
fields.help: Manufacturer of the recorder (filled from the deployment record when known).

fields.name: recorder_model
fields.label: Recorder model
fields.help: Recorder model and hardware revision.

fields.name: recorder_serial
fields.label: Recorder serial number
fields.help: Serial number or device id printed on or in the recorder.

fields.name: firmware_version
fields.label: Firmware version
fields.help: Firmware version running on the recorder.

fields.name: microphone_type
fields.label: Microphone type
fields.help: Built-in or external microphone, and its type.

fields.name: mount_height_m
fields.label: Mount height (m)
fields.help: Height of the microphone above ground, in meters.

fields.name: orientation
fields.label: Orientation
fields.help: Compass direction the microphone faced, and whether the aspect was open or shielded.

fields.name: gain_setting
fields.label: Gain setting
fields.help: Gain or sensitivity setting used.

fields.name: sample_rate_setting
fields.label: Sample rate setting (Hz)
fields.help: Sample rate the recorder was set to, in Hz.

fields.name: recording_schedule
fields.example: 1 min every 5 min, 04:30 to 09:30 and 19:00 to 22:00
fields.label: Recording schedule
fields.help: Duty cycle and daily windows, for example 1 min every 5 min from 04:30 to 09:30.

fields.name: deployment_start
fields.label: Deployment start
fields.help: When the recorder was switched on in the field.

fields.name: deployment_end
fields.label: Deployment end
fields.help: When the recorder was collected. Leave blank if it is still out.

fields.name: gps_accuracy_m
fields.label: GPS accuracy (m)
fields.help: Reported accuracy of the recorder coordinates, in meters.

fields.name: distance_to_edge_m
fields.label: Distance to habitat edge (m)
fields.help: Distance from the recorder to the nearest habitat edge, in meters.

fields.name: deployment_photo
fields.label: Deployment photo
fields.help: Upload a photo of the recorder in place (png or jpg). It is placed on the site page.

fields.name: deployed_by
fields.label: Deployed by
fields.help: Who placed and collected the recorder.

fields.name: weather_summary
fields.example: Clear, 8 to 14 C, wind under 3 m/s on survey mornings
fields.label: Weather summary
fields.help: Weather during the recording windows, especially wind and rain.

fields.name: survey_protocol_reference
fields.example: UK ecoacoustic good practice quick-start, adapted
fields.label: Survey protocol reference
fields.help: A published protocol or guideline the deployment followed, if any.

fields.name: reviewer_name
fields.label: Reviewer name
fields.help: Who listened to and reviewed detection events.

fields.name: reviewer_qualifications
fields.example: 10 years NY breeding bird atlas volunteer; eBird reviewer
fields.label: Reviewer qualifications
fields.help: Experience relevant to identifying the species by sound.

fields.name: review_date
fields.label: Review date
fields.help: When the review was done.

fields.name: validation_method
fields.example: All events above 0.60 listened to; 20 random events per species below 0.60
fields.label: Validation method
fields.help: How events were chosen for review and what was checked.

fields.name: analytics_provider
fields.example: Approved PV Nature data analytics provider name
fields.label: Analytics provider
fields.help: For PV Nature: the approved third-party data analytics provider responsible for species identification.

fields.name: participant_name
fields.label: Participant name (as on contract)
fields.help: Exactly as it appears on the NRCS contract.

fields.name: nrcs_program
fields.label: NRCS program
fields.help: EQIP, CSP, RCPP or other.

fields.name: nrcs_contract_number
fields.label: NRCS contract number
fields.help: Contract number from the CPA-1202.

fields.name: fsa_farm_number
fields.label: FSA farm number
fields.help: Farm number from FSA-156EZ or farmers.gov.

fields.name: fsa_tract_number
fields.label: FSA tract number
fields.help: Tract number from FSA records.

fields.name: fsa_field_numbers
fields.label: FSA field numbers
fields.help: Field numbers covered by the recordings.

fields.name: practice_code
fields.label: Practice code
fields.help: NRCS conservation practice code, for example 645.

fields.name: practice_name
fields.label: Practice name
fields.help: Name of the practice as in the standard.

fields.name: enhancement_code
fields.label: Enhancement code
fields.help: CSP enhancement code, for example E645D.

fields.name: contract_item_number
fields.label: Contract item number
fields.help: Contract item number (CIN) the documentation supports.

fields.name: planned_amount
fields.label: Planned amount
fields.help: Planned amount from the schedule of operations.

fields.name: applied_amount
fields.label: Applied amount
fields.help: Amount applied so far.

fields.name: amount_unit
fields.label: Amount unit
fields.help: Unit of the amounts: ac, ft, no or ea.

fields.name: fiscal_year
fields.label: Fiscal year
fields.help: Fiscal year the item is scheduled or completed in.

fields.name: nrcs_planner_name
fields.label: NRCS planner name
fields.help: District conservationist or planner handling the case file.

fields.name: conservation_plan_id
fields.label: Conservation plan ID
fields.help: Conservation plan identifier from the case file.

fields.name: target_species
fields.label: Target species
fields.help: Species named in the plan that the monitoring looks for.

fields.name: habitat_objectives
fields.example: Maintain 8 to 12 inch residual cover through July 15
fields.label: Habitat objectives
fields.help: Habitat objectives from the plan, in the planner's words.

fields.name: limiting_factors
fields.example: Early hay cutting; lack of residual cover
fields.label: Limiting factors
fields.help: Habitat-limiting factors identified in the evaluation.

fields.name: habitat_management_plan_reference
fields.label: Habitat management plan reference
fields.help: Title and date of the plan this evidence supports.

fields.name: management_action_dates
fields.label: Management actions and dates
fields.help: Dated management actions during the period, one row each.

fields.name: tract_map_image
fields.label: Tract map image
fields.help: Upload the FSA tract map (png or jpg); recorder points are described next to it.

fields.name: aem_id
fields.label: AEM identification number
fields.help: Tier 1 AEM identification number.

fields.name: county_swcd
fields.label: County SWCD
fields.help: County Soil and Water Conservation District.

fields.name: swcd_planner_name
fields.label: SWCD planner name
fields.help: District planner doing the evaluation.

fields.name: evaluating_agency
fields.label: Evaluating agency
fields.help: Agency responsible for the evaluation.

fields.name: farm_name
fields.label: Farm name
fields.help: Farm name as on the AEM Tier 1 form.

fields.name: owner_name
fields.label: Owner name
fields.help: Owner's name as on the Tier 1 form.

fields.name: operator_name
fields.label: Operator name
fields.help: Operator's name as on the Tier 1 form.

fields.name: watershed_name
fields.label: Watershed name
fields.help: Watershed from the Tier 1 form.

fields.name: huc12
fields.label: HUC-12 code
fields.help: 12-digit hydrologic unit code.

fields.name: aem_tier
fields.label: AEM tier
fields.help: 5A (business practice changes) or 5B (installed BMP evaluation).

fields.name: bmp_system
options: Stream Corridor and Shoreline Management System
fields.label: BMP system
fields.help: BMP system from the NYS Agricultural BMP Systems Catalogue.

fields.name: bmp_install_date
fields.label: BMP installation date
fields.help: Date the BMP was completed.

fields.name: funding_program
fields.label: Funding program
fields.help: Program that funded the BMP.

fields.name: project_contract_number
fields.label: Project or contract number
fields.help: Project or contract number for the BMP.

fields.name: tier2_worksheets_completed
fields.label: Tier 2 worksheets completed
fields.help: Tier 2 worksheets this evidence relates to.

fields.name: worksheet_rows_addressed
example: Stream and Floodplain 8 streamside vegetation width
fields.label: Worksheet rows addressed
fields.help: Specific worksheet rows the evidence speaks to.

fields.name: level_of_concern_before
fields.label: Level of concern before (1 to 4)
fields.help: Planner's rating before the BMP, 1 (low) to 4 (high). The planner owns this rating.

fields.name: level_of_concern_after
fields.label: Level of concern after (1 to 4)
fields.help: Planner's rating after the BMP, 1 (low) to 4 (high). The planner owns this rating.

fields.name: planner_notes
fields.label: Planner notes
fields.help: Free text from the planner.

fields.name: certification_program
fields.label: Certification program
fields.help: Which certification the summary is for.

fields.name: certifier_name
fields.label: Certifier or verifier
fields.help: Certifier, verifier or hub doing the review.

fields.name: certification_id
fields.label: Certification ID
fields.help: Certificate or application number.

fields.name: audit_date
fields.label: Audit date
fields.help: Date of the audit or verification visit.

fields.name: operation_name
fields.label: Operation name
fields.help: Name of the operation under certification.

fields.name: land_base_acres
fields.label: Land base (acres)
fields.help: Total land base covered by the certification, in acres.

fields.name: pasture_or_paddock_ids
fields.label: Pasture or paddock IDs
fields.help: Pastures or paddocks the sites fall in.

fields.name: grazing_system_description
fields.example: Adaptive multi-paddock, 1 to 3 day moves, 35 day rest
fields.label: Grazing or cropping system
fields.help: How the land is grazed or cropped, including rest periods.

fields.name: habitat_practices
fields.label: Habitat practices in place
fields.help: Habitat practices in place (for example the ROC 2.8 list).

fields.name: hmp_reference
fields.label: Habitat Management Plan reference
fields.help: Audubon Conservation Ranching Habitat Management Plan reference, if any.

fields.name: priority_species
fields.label: Priority species
fields.help: Species the program or plan treats as priority.

fields.name: sensitive_areas
fields.example: Wet meadow in P7 excluded May to July
fields.label: Sensitive areas
fields.help: Areas with seasonal exclusions or special management.

fields.name: eov_site_ids
fields.label: EOV monitoring site IDs
fields.help: Land to Market EOV long-term monitoring site ids the Thicket sites map to.

fields.name: management_changes_since_last_period
fields.example: Added 2 paddocks; first cut moved to after Aug 1
fields.label: Management changes since last period
fields.help: What changed on the land since the previous report.

fields.name: project_id
fields.label: Project ID
fields.help: Registry project identifier.

fields.name: registry
fields.label: Registry
fields.help: Registry or standard family the project is listed with.

fields.name: standard_version
fields.example: PV Nature Methodology and Data Protocol v1.2
fields.label: Standard and version
fields.help: Exact standard, methodology and version.

fields.name: project_proponent
fields.label: Project proponent
fields.help: Legal entity responsible for the project.

fields.name: monitoring_period_start
fields.label: Monitoring period start
fields.help: First day of the monitoring period under the standard.

fields.name: monitoring_period_end
fields.label: Monitoring period end
fields.help: Last day of the monitoring period under the standard.

fields.name: project_boundary_file
fields.label: Project boundary file
fields.help: Upload the project boundary (image export of the map).

fields.name: strata_definitions
fields.label: Strata definitions
fields.help: Strata with habitat type and area, one row each.

fields.name: vvb_name
fields.label: Validation/verification body
fields.help: Validation and verification body, if assigned.

fields.name: land_tenure_note
fields.label: Land tenure note
fields.help: Ownership or easement situation of the land.

fields.name: indicator_set
fields.label: Indicator set
fields.help: Indicators the monitoring plan commits to.

fields.name: sampling_design_description
fields.example: 1 point per 10 ha, stratified by habitat, 100 m spacing, 7 nights per season
fields.label: Sampling design
fields.help: Sites per stratum, spacing, effort, season and repeats.

fields.name: reference_site_ids
fields.label: Reference site IDs
fields.help: Reference or control sites, if any.

fields.name: deviations_from_plan
fields.example: Recorder at S1-3 failed night 4; redeployed night 5
fields.label: Deviations from the plan
fields.help: Anything that did not go as planned, and what was done about it.

fields.name: chain_of_custody_notes
fields.example: SD cards collected by S. Mehta, uploaded same day, hashes recorded
fields.label: Chain of custody notes
fields.help: How files moved from the recorder to Thicket, and who handled them.

fields.name: baseline_period_reference
fields.label: Baseline period reference
fields.help: Which earlier analyses or period serve as the baseline.

fields.name: baseline_analysis_ids
fields.label: Baseline analysis IDs
fields.help: Thicket analysis ids that form the baseline.

fields.name: follow_up_analysis_ids
fields.label: Follow-up analysis IDs
fields.help: Thicket analysis ids that form the follow-up.

fields.name: uncertainty_method
fields.label: Uncertainty method
fields.help: How intervals or uncertainty were estimated.

fields.name: qaqc_notes
fields.example: 3 recordings excluded for rain per QC head
fields.label: QA/QC notes
fields.help: Recordings excluded and why, duplicate and clock checks, other QA steps.

fields.name: data_access_conditions
fields.example: Raw audio available to the VVB on request for 5 years
fields.label: Data access conditions
fields.help: Who can access raw audio and data, and for how long.

fields.name: public_summary_text
fields.example: One paragraph for the public registry page
fields.label: Public summary
fields.help: One paragraph suitable for a public registry page.

fields.name: audio_retention_statement
fields.example: Raw WAV retained offline for 5 years; Thicket RETAIN_AUDIO=false
fields.label: Audio retention statement
fields.help: Where the raw audio is kept, for how long, and the Thicket retention setting.

fields.name: data_license
fields.label: Data license
fields.help: License the exported data is shared under.

fields.name: privacy_statement
fields.example: Recordings with detected speech were excluded from export
fields.label: Privacy statement
fields.help: How recordings with possible speech were handled.

fields.name: landowner_consent
fields.label: Landowner consent to record
fields.help: Confirm the landowner agreed to acoustic recording on the land.

fields.name: caveats_acknowledged
fields.label: Caveats acknowledged
fields.help: Confirm you have read the limitations page.

fields.name: attestation_name
fields.label: Attestation name
fields.help: Name of the person attesting that the report is accurate to their knowledge.

fields.name: attestation_date
fields.label: Attestation date
fields.help: Date of the attestation.
